title: Executive Turntable: Samantha Juneman Named Head of Music at Mattel
summary: Warner Music launches Warner Records Germany, Xelon launched a new London office and a new agent joins Paladin Artists.
contentText:
Samantha Juneman joined Mattel as the company’s head of music, stepping into her new position on Aug. 31. In her new role, Juneman will report to Natalia Premovic , chief consumer productions and experiences officer.

Juneman was previously senior vp at the Irving Azoff-owned Iconic Artists Group, where she helped preserve the legacy of artists such as Wu-Tang Clan, Frank Sinatra, Cher and more. Prior to her tenure at Iconic, she held executive leadership positions at IPG Media Group, Universal Music Group and Warner Music. — Ariel King

Warner Records Germany Launches

Warner Records Germany has launched in Berlin with Lea Londa leading the new label as director. She will report to Jean-Sebastien Permal , senior vp of A&R for Central Europe and EMEA at Warner Music Central Europe.

“Warner Records has always been a label built around iconic, visionary artists,” Aaron Bay-Schuck , CEO and co-chairman of Warner Records, and Tom Corson , COO and co-chairman of Warner Records and COO of Warner Music Group, said in a joint statement. “Launching Warner Records Germany reinforces our global commitment to championing creative talent, empowering the German team to discover, nurture and elevate the next generation of artists both in Germany and on the world stage.”

Perman said, “Launching Warner Records Germany is a defining step in our growth, and Lea was the clear choice to lead it. She has spent her career earning the trust of artists, and she bring s a sharp point of view about what a modern frontline label should give them. Under her leadership from Berlin, Warner Records Germany will become a genuine home for artists at every stage of their careers.”

Londa said, “Bringing the iconic legacy of Warner Records to Germany is a pivotal moment, and I am grateful to both Niels and Seb for their trust in my vision to lead this new chapter. I am excited to shape this future w with the artists I have worked closely with for years, and to welcome new talent into a true musical home. Together with the team, we will build a creative culture that makes Warner Records Germany a successful force in the market.”

Neils Walboomers , president of Warner Music Central Europe, said, “Bringing the legendary Warner Records brand to Germany underscores our commitment to the region. We are building an elite, modern label model that puts artists first and drives domestic culture forward. I’m thrilled to support Lea and Seb as they lead this charge from the heart of Berlin.” — Ariel King
